answer: The marble is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the gale. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the prism of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing.
